items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And then we had Steve Lewis. On piano. Yes. Steve Lewis was on piano. Johnny Dodds on clarinet, and Mud Carey on the cornet.

ctx.x: Oh, who went with you in 1914?
This is when we took Johnny Dodds and them around, but we didn't go directly to...
No, we didn't. We were taking Johnny Dodds and them in 1918.
